blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 DoT & TSDSI Sign MoU under ₹203 Crore 'TDIP Scheme' for Bharat 6G Standardisation. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Provides up to 98% financial support to Indian startups/MSMEs for global SDO participation.
TDIP Scheme Outlay: ₹203 crore outlay (2026-2031) under Technology Development and Investment Promotion Scheme.
Financial Support: Up to 98% funding for startups (turnover ≤ ₹10 cr) and 80% (turnover ₹10 cr – ₹500 cr) to participate in 3GPP, ITU, and oneM2M standards meetings.
Startup support limit (98% for turnover ≤ ₹10 cr) vs mid-sized MSME support limit (80%).
